prompt: Why will the café wait before telling most guests the roast names?
promptZh: 咖啡店為什麼不立刻告訴大多數客人各杯是哪種烘焙品項？

options.text: To let guests take notes before learning what they tasted.
options.zh: 讓客人先記心得，再知道喝到哪一款。
options.whyZh: 店員說要先讓客人寫完心得，再揭曉試飲的品項。

options.text: To give the staff time to roast more beans.
options.zh: 讓店員多一點時間烘焙咖啡豆。
options.whyZh: 沒有說需要再烘豆；延後揭曉與客人的紀錄順序有關。

options.text: To leave room for another card on the counter.
options.zh: 在櫃檯上騰出放另一張卡的地方。
options.whyZh: 圖片卡照樣發，櫃檯空間不是晚點公布品項的理由。

options.text: To wait for the last guest to arrive.
options.whyZh: 揭曉的時點取決於客人寫完心得，不是最後一人何時抵達。

explanationZh: 店員說要先讓客人寫完心得，再揭曉試飲的品項。
evidence: We'll tell people what they tried after they've made their notes.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: We'll tell people what they tried after they've made their notes.

vocabulary.note: 先寫下試飲感想，再得知品項。
